Overview.Name: Harika
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Thursday and Sunday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chapati (2–3) & chicken curry (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & cooked vegetables
Meal_2 (Main Heavy Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & curd + vegetable curry
Option 2: Chapati (2–3) & paneer bhurji (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd rice + chicken soup

Notes_and_Tips: Since the goal is healthy weight gain and energy improvement, avoid skipping meals.
Both meals should be proper full meals to improve strength and recovery.
Avoid non-veg on Thursday and Sunday and follow vegetarian options.
Field work and shift timings can reduce appetite, so keep meals simple and easy to eat.
Regular meals, sleep and hydration will improve energy and healthy weight gain.
